args.title: Retail Returns Summary (Brightline + Companion)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a significant cost driver for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduced handling costs by about 20% (one-fifth), showing centralization as an effective mitigation strategy.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of their original margin, underscoring the importance of speed in the resale pipeline.
